values.description: A list of `Tensor` objects or a single `Tensor`.
constraints: Each element must be a Tensor.

axis.description: 0-D `int32` `Tensor`. Dimension along which to concatenate. Must be in the range `[-rank(values), rank(values))`. As in Python, indexing for axis is 0-based. Positive axis in the rage of `[0, rank(values))` refers to `axis`-th dimension. And negative axis refers to `axis + rank(values)`-th dimension.
constraints: axis must be one of int32
The number of dimensions of the input tensors must match, and all dimensions except the axis must be equal.

output.description: A `Tensor` resulting from concatenation of the input tensors.
